run_dummy_training: run the dummy training function with hydra config to compute a dummy loss value
run_dummy_training_with_overrides: run dummy training with hydra cli overrides for lr, dropout, batch_size, and db parameters
run_dummy_training_error_mode: run dummy training with cfg.error set to true to trigger a runtime error
review_dummy_training: review the dummy_training function and its hydra main decorator configuration
summarize_dummy_training: summarize the dummy_training function which computes a dummy loss based on hyperparameters
